remarks: PRICE REDUCTION - TAKE ADVANTAGE of this beautifully-crated, custom-built home in Cranbury. It borders Wilton and is minutes from Westport! This house is Fully-Automated and includes All-Programmable Features - Blinds, Heat, Central A/C, Audio Surround Sound, Alarm, Door Locks and All Electronics, including Indoor and Outdoor Lights! High-end materials used on the exterior and interior. Heated front walkway and front steps add to total luxury and less maintenance! This Open Floor Plan Home has everything to allow you to thoroughly enjoy time spent in it and is PERFECT for entertaining!!! Hardwood floors and Thermopane windows throughout. Situated on an acre of level yard, this picturesque house comes with a 2-bay climate-controlled Garage, Elevator, 5-Bedrooms, 3.5 Bathrooms, Gourmet Kitchen, Brand-New Second Floor, Fully-Finished Lower Level with additional Freezer and Double Oven, Full-House Generator, Shed w/ Electricity, Mahogany Deck with Brand-New Retractable Awning and several items included in the sale of this home! This Home is a must-see for the house enthusiast who desires Luxury, Convenience AND Beauty!!!
